title: SILENCE AT THE TABLE
PRAYER FOR HEALING HEARTS
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer

scenes.a: Silence feels heavy at your kitchen table today.
Remember that God sees every distance in your home.
And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
Lord, where hard words or long quiet distance have grown between generations, soften our hearts today.
Turn us back to one another in patience and gentle truth.
Heal what feels broken past mending, and fill every room of this household with Your steady grace. Amen. Silence feels heavy at your kitchen table today.
